title: CBI v. Indrani Mukerjea, Sanjeev Khanna & Shyamvar Rai (Sheena Bora Murder)
crime_type: Familial Premeditated Homicide / Chemical Sedation / Forest Incineration
court_or_authority: Special CBI Sessions Court Mumbai / High Court of Bombay / Supreme Court of India
source: Supreme Court of India Judgment & Indian Kanoon
ipc_sections: Section 364 IPC (Kidnapping in order to murder)
Section 201 IPC (Causing disappearance of evidence of offence)
location: Bandra, Mumbai & Pen, Raigad, Maharashtra, India
evidence: Confession of driver Shyamvar Rai following arrest with illegal weapon disclosing burial of body in Raigad forest
Exhumation of skeletal remains from Pen jungle yielding femurs, teeth, and skull fragments
AIIMS forensic DNA profiling confirming exhumed skeleton was the biological daughter of Indrani Mukerjea
Purchase receipts for luggage bags, medicines, and petrol cans procured on day of crime
Forged resignation email sent in Sheena Bora name three months after her death to conceal disappearance
modus_operandi: High-society media executive lured daughter under pretext of reconciliation. Sedated her with spiked alcoholic beverage in a hired Opel Corsa car, strangled her in the backseat with ex-husband, packed body into a duffel bag, drove to dense forest in Raigad district, doused body in petrol, and burned it in a ravine.
personality_disorder: Malignant narcissism, extreme reputation control, status anxiety, and complete absence of maternal empathy.
common_traits: Homicide inside moving passenger vehicle following chemical sedation
Transporting corpse in luggage bag to rural forest ravine
Post-mortem electronic impersonation (emails, text messages) to simulate overseas emigration
Approver confession breaking three-year cold case deadlock
summary: Sensational high-profile murder trial revealing three years of active deception where the victim was claimed to be living in the United States. Advanced DNA extraction by AIIMS forensic experts played a decisive role in identifying charred skeletal remains.
